evidence.name: TrackSceneLoader

function_ir.summary: Finds and selects a scene by name. Copies the input name into a local buffer, normalizes it via sub_589901, then linearly scans the scene registry: dword_8AC488 entries of stride 396 starting at dword_8AC490, reading each entry's name at offset +260, normalizing it, and comparing with strcmp. On a match sets dword_8AC48C to the matching index; returns the scene count when no entry matches.

operations.description: Copy input a1 into SrcStr and normalize it via sub_589901(SrcStr).
result = dword_8AC488 (scene count) and v2 = 0 before the search.
Guard: search only runs when dword_8AC488 > 0.
Loop over entries with index step 396 (entry stride): read the name at dword_8AC490 + i + 260, byte-copy it into the local buffer v7, normalize via sub_589901(v7), and strcmp against SrcStr.
On a name match, break out of the loop and set dword_8AC48C = v2 (the current scene index).
Return dword_8AC488 (scene count) when the loop exhausts without a match, otherwise return 0 after the match.

unresolved: The normalization transform inside sub_589901 is not evidenced here.
The scene registry layout (name offset +260 within a 396-byte entry) is inferred from the loop arithmetic and is not otherwise documented.
